mapper.insert: insert into edu_qb_practice_session ( user_name, subject_id, paper_title, share_id, total_count, correct_count, choice_count, subjective_count, duration_sec, create_time ) values ( #{userName}, #{subjectId}, #{paperTitle}, #{shareId}, #{totalCount}, #{correctCount}, #{choiceCount}, #{subjectiveCount}, #{durationSec}, now() )

insert into edu_qb_practice_record ( session_id, user_name, question_id, subject_id, chapter_id, chapter_text, question_type, picked_answer, correct_flag, create_time ) values ( #{sessionId}, #{userName}, #{questionId}, #{subjectId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterText}, #{questionType}, #{pickedAnswer}, #{correctFlag}, now() )
mapper.select:
select session_id, user_name, subject_id, paper_title, share_id, total_count, correct_count, choice_count, subjective_count, duration_sec, create_time from edu_qb_practice_session
user_name = #{userName} and subject_id = #{subjectId}
and paper_title ilike ('%' || #{paperTitle} || '%')
order by create_time desc, session_id desc

select session_id, user_name, subject_id, paper_title, share_id, total_count, correct_count, choice_count, subjective_count, duration_sec, create_time from edu_qb_practice_session where session_id = #{sessionId} and user_name = #{userName}

select record_id, session_id, user_name, question_id, subject_id, chapter_id, chapter_text, question_type, picked_answer, correct_flag, create_time from edu_qb_practice_record where session_id = #{sessionId} order by record_id asc

select coalesce(chapter_id, 0) as chapter_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(chapter_text), ''), '\u672a\u5206\u7c7b\u7ae0\u8282') as chapter_text, sum(case when correct_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end)::int as wrong_count, count(*)::int as practice_count, round( sum(case when correct_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end)::numeric / nullif(count(*), 0), 4 ) as wrong_rate from edu_qb_practice_record where user_name = #{userName} and correct_flag in ('0', '1') and subject_id = #{subjectId} group by coalesce(chapter_id, 0), coalesce(nullif(trim(chapter_text), ''), '\u672a\u5206\u7c7b\u7ae0\u8282') having sum(case when correct_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 order by wrong_count desc, wrong_rate desc, practice_count desc limit #{limit}

select count(*)::int as session_count, coalesce(sum(total_count), 0)::int as total_questions, coalesce(sum(correct_count), 0)::int as total_correct, coalesce(sum(choice_count), 0)::int as total_choice from edu_qb_practice_session where user_name = #{userName} and subject_id = #{subjectId}
